hud.overwhelmed.hint: Park it. Swap or rest — both are valid.
overwhelm.title: Parked. That’s allowed.
overwhelm.body: Swap to something lighter, or rest. Nothing to catch up.
unstick.deeper.look: Look at the thing — don’t touch yet
unstick.deeper.touch: Touch it once, then rest your hands
hyperfocus.chip: You’ve been in this stretch for a while. Pause, water, or keep going — all fine.
routing.hint.onset: Onset often suits low or medium load. A hint — ignore anytime.
routing.hint.peak: Peak can hold medium or high load if you want it. A hint — ignore anytime.
routing.hint.comedown: Comedown tends to suit low load. A hint — ignore anytime.
routing.hint.unknown: Zone unknown until a dose is logged. Pick anything.
buffer.label: Time buffer
hyperfocus.setting.hint: After this many continuous minutes. Dismissible. Never cuts focus.
hotkeys.title: Keyboard
hotkeys.body: c or / capture · Space start/pause · d done · u Un-Stick · h Too Hard · o Overwhelmed · s Swap · r Rest
aiBrainDump.label: Brain-dump deconstruction
aiBrainDump.hint: On by default. Local sorting always works offline — no network. Optional enhance uses a key you paste below; stored only on this device. If the key is missing or the request fails, local sorting continues quietly.
aiBrainDump.review: Edit or uncheck anything that isn’t a task. Commit the rest to today, or reject and keep the dump in Park.
aiBrainDump.offline: Offline — using local sorting. That’s enough.
aiBrainDump.llmKey.hint: OpenAI-compatible. Stays in this browser only. Never a server or Cursor secret. Many APIs block browser calls — if so, local sorting still works.
aiBrainDump.committed: On today. One at a time is plenty.
aiBrainDump.empty: Nothing to split — parked as written.
hyperfocus.preview.hint: QA: show the chip on the next focus without waiting 45–90 minutes. Dismissible. Never cuts focus.
restBury.hint: Open bits go to Park. Come back when you want them.
restBury.done: Parked what’s left. Rest is yours.
restBury.override.hint: QA / Item 7: allow Park-and-rest during Comedown or offline without waiting for window minutes. Timing windows themselves are unchanged.
